title: Panther Tracks
tools: Microsoft Word, OneDrive, Adobe Illustrator, Canon EOS 6D, Countless Notebooks
summary: Writing, photography, and production for Seattle Prep’s annual alumni and community magazine.
paragraphs: My first issue of Panther Tracks — Seattle Prep’s annual community and alumni magazine — was published in summer 2023. Since then, I’ve contributed to four issues, writing alumni features and student profiles while capturing, organizing, and selecting imagery that effectively tells the Prep story. It’s a labor of love.

With four issues under my belt, I’ve strengthened my skills as a writer. Before this project, I had only written in academic contexts. Now, my sentences grace the mailboxes and coffee tables of over 10,000 alumni, donors, and families.
Read my favorite pieces from our most recent issue below!

title: Alumni Week Brand Identity
summary: A refreshed Alumni Week identity brought to life across print, web, and digital communications.
paragraphs: Engaging alumni is essential to a healthy, connected school community. To that end, I’ve made a consistent effort to build relationships across generations, from recent Gen Z graduates to Baby Boomers who witnessed Seattle’s transformation into a technology hub.
With insights from those relationships, I helped the Assistant Director of Alumni Engagement revamp Seattle Prep’s annual initiative — Alumni Week.

Drawing on my graphic design skills, I collaborated with the Assistant Director of Alumni Engagement to develop a fresh brand identity that promoted events and opportunities for alumni to reconnect with Seattle Prep. Through direct-mail postcards, an updated website, and digital collateral, we helped alumni discover the many ways to reconnect with the school.
coverAlt: Alumni Week branding with direct mail and event collateral

title: THINK PREP! Seattle Prep’s Admissions Campaign
role: Graphic Design, Writing, Email Marketing, Photography, Video Production, Project/Vendor Management
tools: Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canon EOS 6D, Canon R6 Mark II, iPhone, CapCut, Finalsite Messages, MailChimp, Veracross
summary: An integrated admissions campaign, print design, and content built around THINK PREP!
paragraphs: Seattle hosts a competitive independent school market. A major part of my work is crafting campaign strategies and tactics that help our Admissions Office stand out and spark curiosity among prospective families and students.
Seattle Prep’s THINK PREP! campaign invites prospective families to consider the enduring value of a Jesuit education in the age of AI.

My work with Admissions spans the entire enrollment journey, from initial inquiry to enrollment. I design postcards, posters, and brochures for Open House; conceptualize and produce long- and short-form videos highlighting the school’s differentiators; and develop email campaigns that help prospective families feel confident in their decision to enroll.

title: Social Media Strategy
role: Content Creation, Photography, Content Planning and Management, Graphic Design
tools: Sprout Social, Canon EOS 6D, iPhone, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Lightroom
summary: Platform-specific content strategy, community storytelling, and analytics-informed social media management.
paragraphs: Social media is the modern search engine, putting primary sources and firsthand perspectives at our fingertips. I manage Seattle Prep’s official social channels with an emphasis on strategic content planning, community-centered storytelling, audience growth, and performance analysis.

By creating authentic, platform-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, I help connect the school with current families, prospective students, alumni, and the wider community. Through consistent publishing, data-informed decision-making, and content planning in Sprout Social, I’ve helped increase Instagram engagement by 408%.

title: Prep Post — A Weekly Newsletter
role: Content and Submission Management, Editorial Direction, Photography, Writing, Graphic Design
tools: Finalsite Messages, Canon EOS 6D, Countless Notebooks
summary: Editorial planning, writing, and production of Seattle Prep’s weekly community newsletter.
paragraphs: At 7, my first email account was with Yahoo Mail. I remember the excitement of receiving messages on the now seemingly archaic platform from my favorite cousin, Paty, who had just moved to Utah.
Believe it or not, that childlike excitement has carried over into my email marketing work.

Every Monday during the academic year, I produce Seattle Prep’s weekly newsletter, Prep Post. My process — more a ritual, really — gives me the chance to connect with the school’s entire community. Faculty, staff, and administration alert me to noteworthy material, and I synthesize it into a reliable and readable digital news resource.
Prep Post has maintained an average open rate of 80% under my direction.
